scope_by_subfield.psychology-behavior: Cultural meaning-making, qualitative evidence, theory, methodological work and synthesis. The journal explicitly prioritizes qualitative/theoretical approaches and says it does not publish standard quantitative manuscripts. Ordinary quantitative behavioral analysis without the required cultural theoretical approach is unsuitable. Sage requires disclosure of generative AI and prohibits specified uses, including producing a submission through successive prompts and analysing experiences/themes; ordinary assistive editing has a disclosure exemption. Source: https://www.sagepub.com/journals/publication-ethics-policies/artificial-intelligence-policy. The special Syntheses track is restricted to first authors at Master's level or below, integrates 6–8 articles from this journal, has a 2500-word cap, and requires an advance proposal to the editor. Other theoretical/review contributions must meet the separate named scope categories.
